claim.claim-text: 2. The image-based determination apparatus (3) according to claim 1, further comprising:

a storage unit (302) configured to store the at least one of the first image data and the second image data received by the image reception unit (301); an input unit (303); and a second play unit (318), wherein the determination unit (314) generates a result of the image-based determination operation performed on the first image data and the second image data as an information list (800) that is created using the first image data and the second image data stored in the storage unit (302), wherein, in response to receiving an operation of selecting a particular date and time when a particular result was obtained by performing the image-based determination operation from the information list (800) by operating the input unit (303), the second play unit (318) is configured to play and display, on the display (105), specific image data corresponding to the selected particular date and time by reading the specific image data from the storage unit (302), the specific image data selectable from the first image data and the second image data stored in the storage unit (302).

3. The image-based determination apparatus (3) according to claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the image reception unit (301) receives a part of image data of screen image being displayed on a display disposed for the another device (5), or image data combining the part of image data of screen image.
4. The image-based determination apparatus (3) according to any one of claims 1 to 3,

wherein the another device (5) is a system including another image-based determination apparatus that receives image data from one or more image capture apparatuses, compatible to the one or more image capture apparatuses (2) connected to the image-based determination apparatus (3), wherein the image reception unit (301) receives the image data from the another image-based determination apparatus as the second image data.

5. The image-based determination apparatus (3) according to claim 4, wherein the another device (5) includes the another image-based determination apparatus with the number of two or more connectable in multiple stages, each of the another image-based determination apparatus including the one or more image capture apparatuses, compatible to the one or more image capture apparatuses (2) connected to the image-based determination apparatus (3).
